parameters.description: Session ID

enhanced.description: Enhancement metadata (only present if enhancements requested)

searchOptions.description: Search options for fetching messages (limit, fromMe, etc)

includeReactions.description: Include emoji reactions on messages (adds _enhanced.reactions array)

includeMedia.description: Include detailed media information without downloading (adds _enhanced.mediaInfo object)

includeContacts.description: Include contact card information for vcard messages (adds _enhanced.contacts array)

withMentionsAndQuoted.summary: Fetch with mentions and quoted messages

post.summary: Get view once media from chat
post.description: Retrieves all view once (disappearing) photos and videos from a specific chat. These are media files that are meant to be viewed only once before disappearing.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Session ID

chatId.description: The Chat ID to search for view once media

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to fetch (default: 50)

includeExpired.description: Include expired view once messages (default: false)

post.description: Downloads media from a specific view once message. This allows saving disappearing photos/videos before they expire. Use with caution and respect privacy.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Session ID

warning.example: This is view once media that was meant to be seen only once. Handle responsibly.

500.description: Internal server error or media expired

messageId.description: The message ID containing view once media

chatId.description: The Chat ID where the message is located

force.description: Force download even if expired or already viewed (default: false)

post.description: Retrieves statistics about view once messages in a specific chat, including counts by type, status, sender, and date.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Session ID

chatId.description: The Chat ID to analyze

days.description: Number of days to look back (default: 30)

post.summary: List chats with view once messages
